title: Fortinet says ransomware groups targeting Korea rose from 11 to 24 and disclosed victims 2.4 times in January to October
date_note: Date of the Fortinet summit and the Boannews article; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: At the Fortinet AI Cybersecurity Summit APAC 2026, Fortinet's Kapil Gupta presented an analysis of dark web leak sites, as reported by Boannews. It counts 24 ransomware groups targeting Korea in January to October this year against 11 last year, and 43 organisations with disclosed attacks against 18. Qilin was the most active group and manufacturing had the largest share of victims, at 24%.
plain: Fortinet says 24 ransomware groups targeted Korea in January to October, up from 11 last year, and 43 organisations had disclosed attacks, up from 18.
exec: Fortinet's leak-site analysis, as reported by Boannews, shows more ransomware groups and more disclosed victims in Korea this year.

evidence.quote: 한국을 노린 랜섬웨어 그룹은 지난해 11개에서 올해 1~10월 24개로 2배 넘게 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다.
이 기간 피해 사실이 공개된 조직도 18곳에서 43곳으로 2.4배 늘었다.
킬린(Qilin)이 2년 연속 최다 활동 그룹으로 꼽혔고, 업종별로는 제조업 비중이 24%로 가장 높았다.

validation.note: Fortinet's figures known only through Boannews's report of the summit; Fortinet's own report not found.
